text:
maria: Heads up — org KMS key rotation scheduled 2024-04-02 02:00 UTC. This will change the key ARN used by tf modules and may require a provider reconfigure. Planning a staggered apply during the release window. Need to coordinate deploybot pin/unpin and a safe rollback path.

sandeep: +1. Can we add a provider alias and explicit kms_key_id var so we can roll forward/back without a full state change?

carla: also we should do a canary wave (staging -> int -> prod) and lock state between waves. I can own the canary tenants list.

maria: plan suggestion:
1) Pin aws provider to v4.72.0 in release branch.
2) Run deploybot apply --wave=1 targeting module.kms for staging tenants only.
3) Wait 15m for smoke, then wave=2 for int, then wave=3 for prod with 30m spacing.
4) If any failure, deploybot rollback-to-commit <sha> and we re-pin old kms_key_id var then reapply.

jim: what about state-locking and tfstate drift if we flip key ARNs? We need to ensure replicas don't retry and cause partial writes.

sandeep: use backend lock + deploybot will hold the lock during each wave. Also add an escape hatch: abort on first 5xx from runtime or if error_ratio > 1% observed by canary checks.

maria: adding small snippets below for the ops runbook to paste into deploy chat:

```
# wave 1 (staging)
deploybot pin-release --branch release/kms-rot-2024-04-02
deploybot apply --target=module.kms --wave=1 --wait 900
# monitor logs: cutover-checks query: sum(rate(kms_rotate_errors[5m]))
```

```
# rollback
# pin old key id in tfvar then reapply the module
terraform apply -var=\"kms_key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/OLD-KEY\" -target=module.kms
deploybot unpin-release --reason \"rollback kms rotation\"
```

carla: I put tenant list in the release board: staging-apps, test-buckets, int-api. Will DM the exact names.

deploybot: :robot_face: Scheduled deploybot run created by maria at 2024-04-02T01:45:00Z for release/kms-rot-2024-04-02. Steps: pin -> wave1 -> gate -> wave2 -> gate -> wave3. Use `deploybot abort` to stop.

maria: we should also update release notes with a note about provider pin and the new var kms_key_id so downstream teams can opt into the new key.

jim: ops check: add an alias provider example so code sketch for infra devs:
```
provider \"aws\" {
  region = var.region
  version = \"~> 4.72\"
}
provider \"aws\" {
  alias  = \"replica\"
  region = var.replica_region
}
module \"kms\" {
  source = \"./modules/kms\"
  providers = { aws = aws.replica }
  kms_key_id = var.kms_key_id
}
```

sandeep: if wave fails we revert kms_key_id and run a targeted apply, do not force a full plan across tenants. Avoid mass churn.

maria: agreed. Emergency contacts: @sandeep, @carla, @jim. If deploybot shows `apply: failed` for wave=2, we pause and investigate; do not continue to wave=3.

carla: ack. I'll add a canary smoke checklist to the runbook: 200 OK for /health, S3 read/write smoke for buckets attached, KMS encrypt/decrypt sample.

maria: final ask: security needs to approve key rotation schedule; I pinged @security in #eng-security and they gave a tentative thumbs up pending key policy review.

deploybot: :white_check_mark: pin created: release/kms-rot-2024-04-02 pinned by maria. Next action: await manual `deploybot start` from eng infra leads after security confirmation.

jim: thumbs up from me. If we hit issues we can run `terraform state rm module.kms.aws_kms_key.k` and reimport the old key as a last resort, but document that as a documented risky path.

sandeep: adding monitoring alerts to the release run: create temporary alert rule `KMSRotationErrorRatio > 0.01` -> page oncall.

maria: thanks all. Will draft release notes and the step-by-step runbook and post here before start time. :thumbsup:

carla: :thumbsup:
